p1: Do you live in a house or a flat?
What do you like most about the area where you live?
What do you usually do at the weekend?
Have your free-time activities changed since you were a child?

cue.q: Describe a place in your town or city where you like to spend time.
say: and explain why you like it

p3: Why do some people prefer to spend their free time at home?

p1: Do you work or are you a student?
What do you find most interesting about your work or studies?
Would you like to change anything about your daily routine?
Do you prefer working alone or with other people?

cue.q: Describe a skill you learned that has been useful to you.
say: when and how you learned it
and explain why it has been useful

p3: Which skills will be most important for young people in the future?

p1: Do you enjoy travelling?

cue.q: Describe a journey you remember well.
say: and explain why you remember it so well

p3: How has tourism changed in the last twenty years?
What problems can mass tourism cause for local people?
Do you think people will travel more or less in the future? Why?

p1: How often do you use your phone during the day?
What apps do you use most?
Did you use computers a lot when you were at school?

cue.q: Describe a piece of technology that has changed your life.
say: and explain how it has changed your life

p3: Do you think people spend too much time on their phones?
How has technology changed the way families communicate?
Should children's use of technology be limited? Who should decide?

p1: What kind of food do you like?
Do you prefer eating at home or in restaurants?
Did you eat differently when you were a child?
Do you think you have a healthy lifestyle?

cue.q: Describe a meal you enjoyed with other people.
say: and explain why you enjoyed it

p3: Why do many people find it hard to eat healthily?
Should governments tax unhealthy food?

p1: Do you have a large family?

say: and explain how they have influenced you

cue.q: Describe a book or article that made you think.
say: and explain how it changed your thinking

p3: Why do fewer young people read books for pleasure today?
Should schools let children choose what they read?

p1: What's the weather like where you live?

say: and explain how you felt about it

p1: What kind of music do you listen to?

say: and explain why it is special to you

p3: Why is music important in different cultures?
Should music be a compulsory subject at school?
How has the way people listen to music changed?

p1: Do you enjoy shopping?

say: and explain why you were so happy with it

say: and explain why it was memorable

p3: Why do some people dislike exercise?
Are professional athletes paid too much?

p1: How long have you lived in your neighbourhood?

say: and explain why you enjoyed it

cue.q: Describe a form of transport you enjoy using.
